sections.markdown:
## C — Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings

FACT_ID: sec12-F01 | anchor: A62
When another vehicle passes, remain in your lane and keep your speed steady unless an emergency requires a different response. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F02 | anchor: A62
When passing parked vehicles, watch for exhaust, illuminated brake or reverse lamps, a flashing turn signal or front wheels turning toward traffic. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F03 | anchor: A62
A person in a parked vehicle's driving position can indicate that it may pull out. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F04 | anchor: A62
Watch for people or animals coming from between parked vehicles. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F05 | anchor: A62
Signal before changing lanes or moving into or out of a parking space. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F06 | anchor: A62
Signal when entering traffic from a parking area or alley. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F07 | anchor: A62
Give a signal at least one hundred feet before turning or moving laterally. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F08 | anchor: A62
Double broken yellow markings can identify a reversible lane whose direction is controlled by signs or signals. [A62]
Source: [A62 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec12-F09 | anchor: A63
Before a lane change, signal and check the rearview and side mirrors. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F10 | anchor: A63
Look over the appropriate shoulder for a blind-spot vehicle and check for another driver moving into the same lane. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F11 | anchor: A63
Do not change lanes inside an intersection. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F12 | anchor: A63
Plan a turn early and occupy the appropriate lane well before the turn. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F13 | anchor: A63
Signal the turn, slow down and check for people or vehicles in the turning path and behind. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F14 | anchor: A63
Finish a turn in the appropriate lane and adjust speed to the traffic flow. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F15 | anchor: A63
Make a right turn as close to the road's right side as practical. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F16 | anchor: A63
If no center lane is marked, begin a left turn from the lawful left lane and finish in the lawful left lane. [A63]
Source: [A63 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec12-F17 | anchor: A64
Signs and lane markings identify double turn lanes; traffic next to the curb turns into the lane next to the curb. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-F18 | anchor: A64
In the second turn lane from the curb, follow its lane line into the indicated nearest lane. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-F19 | anchor: A64
For an emergency roadside stop, signal and move as far from traffic onto the shoulder as possible. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-F20 | anchor: A64
In the described roadside stop, park parallel to and within twelve inches of the curb or road edge. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-F21 | anchor: A64
For that roadside stop, use the road's right side unless it is a one-way street. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-F22 | anchor: A64
Secure the stopped vehicle against movement by selecting the proper parking gear and applying the parking brake. [A64]
Source: [A64 -> pdf-0064]

FACT_ID: sec12-F23 | anchor: A65
After the emergency roadside stop, use hazard flashers, shut off the engine, remove the keys and check traffic before getting out. [A65] [A64]
Source: [A65 -> pdf-0065]

Misconceptions: A crossing must have room beyond the rails before entry; accessible parking privileges do not authorize occupying an access aisle.
Mnemonics: Signal, check, use the correct lane; stop clear of rails and keep an escape space.
Glossary: ENS identifies the railroad emergency-notification system; an access aisle provides space beside accessible parking; a blind spot lies outside mirror coverage.
Dynamic facts: Live contact details, services and variable fees are withheld from this stable inventory.
